title: feat(ui): "Wireframe, see-through" display mode
body:
Stacked on #2835 (merge #2835 first).

## What changed

- The Display menu has a fifth display mode: "Wireframe, see-through". It stands after "Wireframe".
- The mode draws each edge of the model and of the stock, front and back.
- The mode draws no face. No face goes to the color buffer. No face goes to the depth buffer.
- The model hides nothing behind it: not the stock, not a fixture, not a toolpath.
- A click in the mode picks hidden edges too. The "Pick through" switch stays as the user set it.
- The wireframe switch of the toolbar shows as active in the two wireframe modes. One press in either mode gives "Shaded, with edges".
- The view file stores the mode with the key `wireframe-see-through`.
- The traced stock is a shaded surface. The mode draws the stock wire in its place, as "Wireframe" does.

#2835 gives the other parts of #2636: "Shaded" (faces, no edges), the draw list of each mode, and the saved display mode. This PR adds only the mode that #2835 left out.

The picking rule of the mode:

1. Each edge can be picked, front or back.
2. The edge that draws nearest to the cursor wins.
3. When two edges draw at the same distance from the cursor, the edge nearest to the camera wins.

This is the existing rule of `camcraft_app::pick::pick_bodies` with `through`. The mode asks for `through`.

## Cause

This is new work that the maintainer asked for in #2636. The viewport had no wireframe mode that shows the hidden edges.

## Tests

New pins:

- `ui::draw_list::tests::see_through_wireframe_draws_each_edge_and_no_face`
- `egui_app::tests::see_through::the_see_through_entry_exists_sets_its_mode_and_shows_the_check`
- `egui_app::tests::see_through::the_see_through_mode_is_kept_in_the_view_file`
- `egui_app::tests::see_through::in_see_through_a_click_over_a_hidden_edge_picks_that_edge`
- `egui_app::tests::see_through::the_wireframe_switch_leaves_see_through_for_the_default_mode`
- `egui_app::tests::see_through::the_hidden_line_wireframe_still_picks_only_what_is_in_sight` (a control: "Wireframe" keeps its pick. It is green before and after.)
- `feature_pick::see_through_takes_the_edge_nearest_the_cursor_then_nearest_the_eye` (`camcraft-app`). It states the picking rule. The rule is not new, so this test is green before and after.

Red before the change: the five pins of the new behaviour failed on the unchanged base (#2835 head `b5718f464`). They then read the mode by its stored key, so that they compiled. The draw list was `[Faces, Edges, Stock, Edges, Region]`. The menu had no entry. The click took the near face.

Mutation results (the guard was broken, the pin went red, the guard was restored, the pin went green):

| Broken guard | Red test |
|---|---|
| `draw_list::plan`: the mode pushes a face step | `see_through_wireframe_draws_each_edge_and_no_face` |
| `feature_click::query_at`: the mode does not ask for `through` | `in_see_through_a_click_over_a_hidden_edge_picks_that_edge` |
| `viewport_bar::act`: the switch knows only "Wireframe" | `the_wireframe_switch_leaves_see_through_for_the_default_mode`, `display_button_toggles_the_menu_and_wire_works_from_each_mode` |
| `DisplayMode::ALL`: the mode is not in the list | `the_see_through_entry_exists_...`, `the_see_through_mode_is_kept_in_the_view_file`, `layout_window_display_menu`, `the_display_button_opens_and_closes_the_menu_and_the_labels_exist` |

Changed tests (the change explains each):

- `layout_window_display_menu` and `the_display_button_opens_and_closes_the_menu_and_the_labels_exist` list the new entry.
- `display_button_toggles_the_menu_and_wire_works_from_each_mode` checks the switch from the new mode.

## Goldens moved

None. No `.nc` file, no `.cl` file and no snapshot PNG changed.

## Not exercised

- The wasm build did not run. The mode uses only code that the two shells share.
- No GPU pixel test of the mode. The draw list test and the screenshots show the pass.
- No frame time measurement. The mode draws the cached edge buffers and builds nothing on a frame.
- The pixel snapshots (release lane).
- No person used the mode in the real window.
- Hidden edges do not draw in a lighter tone. The issue says "may". `docs/decisions/2636-see-through-wireframe.md` gives the reason.
- Box selection does not take hidden edges in the mode. It follows the "Pick through" switch, as before.

## Overlaps

- #2835: this PR is stacked on it. It changes the same functions: `draw_list::plan`, `DisplayMode` and its words in `display_mode.rs`, `viewport_bar::act` and `viewport_bar::draw`, and the Display menu tests.
- #2783 changes `viewport_bar.rs` (`act` and `draw`, other lines). Whichever merges second refreshes.
- #2786, #2773, #2763, #2678, #2554, #2893 change `state.rs` or `egui_app/tests.rs` in other functions. Whichever merges second refreshes.

No new command, so no MCP tool is owed. Decision record: `docs/decisions/2636-see-through-wireframe.md`.

Effort: high

Changelog: The Display menu has a fifth display mode, "Wireframe, see-through": each edge draws, front and back, the model hides nothing behind it, and a click picks hidden edges too.

Fixes #2636
